name: Python
summary: Asynchronous event loops, data pipelines, typing with Mypy, and PyTest harness integration.

rubricRequirements.novice: Basic scripts, PEP8 conformity, virtualenv setup.
rubricRequirements.capable: Type annotations, unit testing with pytest >80%, package builds.
rubricRequirements.advanced: Asyncio optimization, concurrency profiling, custom C-extensions or metaclasses.
rubricRequirements.champion: Core library maintainer, author of published PyPI package, org-wide architectural guidelines.

name: React
summary: Modern component lifecycle, custom hooks, state coordination, and server components.

rubricRequirements.novice: JSX syntax, standard state/effects, single page navigation.
rubricRequirements.capable: Custom hooks, memoization strategy, accessibility WCAG AA, testing library tests.
rubricRequirements.advanced: Micro-frontend architecture, custom reconciliation, zero-bundle optimization.
rubricRequirements.champion: Author of open-source design system, state engine contributor, conference speaker.

name: TypeScript
summary: Strict compiler configuration, conditional types, template literal types, and AST transformations.

rubricRequirements.capable: Generics, union discriminating types, strictNullChecks, library d.ts typings.
rubricRequirements.advanced: Mapped & conditional types, recursive AST types, custom ESLint/TS compiler plugins.
rubricRequirements.champion: Compiler contributor, RFC author for type system evolutions, community educator.

name: OSINT (Open Source Intelligence)
summary: Public record synthesis, domain telemetry mapping, certificate transparency analysis, and structured report generation.

rubricRequirements.novice: Search operators, DNS queries, public repository audits.
rubricRequirements.capable: Automated footprint collection, SOCMINT workflows, correlation matrices, clean provenance chains.
rubricRequirements.advanced: Custom scraping pipelines, maltego/spiderfoot extensions, counter-deception detection.
rubricRequirements.champion: Published investigative reports cited by peer research, forensic framework author.

name: AI & Machine Learning Engineering
summary: Prompt engineering harnesses, fine-tuning evaluations, vector retrieval systems, and multimodal tool calling.

rubricRequirements.novice: API client calls, basic prompt structure, deterministic temperature tuning.
rubricRequirements.capable: RAG architecture, embeddings distance evaluation, automated eval benchmark suites.
rubricRequirements.advanced: LoRA fine-tuning, quantized inference hosting, latency budget optimization.
rubricRequirements.champion: Novel model architecture or evaluation benchmark published, widespread production impact.

name: Cybersecurity & Threat Modeling
summary: Zero Trust architecture, automated SAST/DAST pipelines, memory safety audits, and container hardening.

rubricRequirements.novice: OWASP Top 10 awareness, dependency vulnerability auditing (npm audit, Snyk).
rubricRequirements.capable: Threat modeling with STRIDE, cryptographic signature validation, secret scanning CI gates.
rubricRequirements.advanced: Zero-day vulnerability reproduction, custom eBPF kernel telemetry, automated fuzzing harnesses.
rubricRequirements.champion: Coordinated CVE disclosure, author of security standards or cryptographic protocols.
